scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n WEB,API -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @mega/web" "npm run dev -w @mega/api"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @mega/contracts && npm run build -w @mega/api && npm run build -w @mega/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @mega/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @mega/contracts && npm run test -w @mega/api
scripts.format: prettier --write apps packages samples README.md package.json
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n WEB,API -c magenta,cyan "npm run start -w @mega/web" "npm run start -w @mega/api"
